notes_for_editor: Only one index listing exists (Firelookout.ca slug hunter-fire-lookout, id 13986) and it is a bare point. The federal gazetteer's Mount Hunter (51.291666, -116.703056, adopted 1924) lies about 9 km north-west of the pin (my calculation); it is not cited in the story. The index entry may refer to one of the two Mount Hunter lookouts in Yoho National Park or to nothing at all; the sources do not say. The footnote 4 title is the live Parks Canada page's own title, Hikes and walks - Yoho National Park (checked 2026-10-20). The story now uses the index's own place name, Columbia-Shuswap, instead of the Columbia Shuswap Regional District label, which the index does not give. The Canada Lookouts site is described as a list of lookouts by province, since its pages show a British Columbia index and no history label. The Canada Lookouts page does not explain its 'Removed' status. A different, restored lookout, the Mara lookout on Morton Peak in the Hunters Range (Shuswap), is a likely source of confusion; a Shuswap Passion post describes it and was skimmed, not footnoted.
